label: Agrisoil ingest
info:
agrisoil/+/reading -> PostgreSQL (devices + readings).
A new DEVICE_ID is added to `devices` on its first reading, no config needed.
Single Node-RED replica, so a plain subscription. With more replicas use $share/ingest/agrisoil/+/reading.

name: validate + map
upsert device + insert reading
query:
WITH dev AS (
  INSERT INTO devices (id, name, first_seen, last_seen, last_lat, last_lng)
  VALUES ($1, $1, LEAST($2::timestamptz, now()), LEAST($2::timestamptz, now()), $13::float8, $14::float8)
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    last_seen = GREATEST(devices.last_seen, EXCLUDED.last_seen),
    last_lat  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_lat, devices.last_lat),
    last_lng  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_lng, devices.last_lng)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO readings (device_id, ts, n, p, k, ph, moist,
                      npk1_raw, npk2_raw, moist_raw, ph_raw, in_soil, lat, lng)
SELECT id, $2::timestamptz, $3::real, $4::real, $5::real, $6::real, $7::real,
       $8::int, $9::int, $10::int, $11::int, $12::boolean, $13::float8, $14::float8
FROM dev
ON CONFLICT (device_id, ts) DO NOTHING;
